description: This Java class defines a PhotoManager that manages background thread pools for downloading and decoding images from URLs, maintains an image cache, and communicates UI updates via a Handler. It implements singleton pattern and handles tasks related to image download and processing.

classes.name: PhotoManager
classes.description: This class manages thread pools for downloading and decoding images, maintains an image cache, handles UI updates via a Handler, and implements singleton pattern for overall image processing in the app.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PhotoManager.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Handles state messages for a photo task, updating the cache and UI according to the task's progress.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Interrupts all ongoing download tasks and clears the download work queue.

methods.name: removeDownload
methods.description: Removes and interrupts a specific download task based on the provided URL.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Initiates download and decoding of an image for a given PhotoView, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: recycleTask
methods.description: Recycles a PhotoTask object by resetting and re-adding it to the task pool.
